Source molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_records, compound_structures, activities, docs, assays, target_dictionary. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno to include parent and salts. Join compound_records on molregno. Join activities on record_id. Join docs on doc_id. Join assays on assay_id. Join target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_structures on molregno. Filter molecule_dictionary.chembl_id for CHEMBL376359 and its salts via parent mapping. Filter activities.standard_type for IC50. Filter activities.standard_units for nM. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id for CHEMBL284. Sort by compound_chembl_id, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
